'''Kellor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he worked for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], and aided [[Havoc Squad]]'s search for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Torius]]. Kellor's team crashed in the [[Nightmare Lands]] after they were spotted while tracking Torius, and Kellor subsequently lost his mind, [[Death/Legends|killing]] his teammates. Havoc Squad located him in the Nightmare Lands, and retrieved his information before he died.
